agent_report.summary: Implemented weekly goals and week progress (Issue #18), closing the Weekly Awareness section of GOAL.md. Added a `weeks` top-level state map keyed by `weekStart`, a `getWeek` accessor that normalises a missing `weeks` map on read (mirroring `getDay`'s handling of `commitments`), dedicated `addGoal`/`toggleGoal`/`removeGoal` functions, and a pure `weekProgress(state, dayKey)` summing completed/total across priorities, tasks and commitments for the selected week. Added a "This Week" panel below the day panels (index.html/app.js/styles.css) with progress text + a decorative bar and a goals list reusing the existing item/add-form patterns. Documented all design decisions in DECISIONS.md. Added 11 new Playwright tests (42 total, all passing) covering persistence, toggle/delete, empty-week and cross-week progress, backward compatibility with pre-`weeks` payloads, keyboard operability, non-color distinguishability, and 360px no-scroll, plus two new screenshots. Opened PR #19.
